paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: automatically resume sessions interrupted by app closure
# dsh-session-auto-resume
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that **automatically resumes agent sessions interrupted by app closure**.
When the DSH host relaunches, sessions that were mid-work at closure are detected from persisted sta
te and recovered without human action:
- **Sessions with an active goal** are explicitly resumed and the goal re-armed — after which the bu
ndled `goal-round-driver` continues the round budget automatically. (The driver deliberately "never

revives work on its own"; this plugin performs the explicit resume the driver requires.)
- **Mid-tur
n sessions without a goal** are detected and logged with a ready-to-run resume command — surfaced, n

ever auto-worked.
- Cleanly-ended, stale (>48 h), live, and subagent-owned sessions are skipped. Per
-boot resume cap. Fail-closed on goal transitions. Never-throw activation.
## Why
The desktop host has quit-time inspection of active work but **no startup recovery path**: after any
closure (crash, SIGTERM, deliberate quit/reload), interrupted sessions stay interrupted until a hum
an notices. This plugin closes that gap entirely outside the app bundle, so it survives app updates.
## Live verification
Tested against a real closure-then-relaunch cycle (operator-approved SIGTERM of the running host; ap
a real closure-then-relaunch cycle (operator-approved SIGTERM of the running host; app relaunched):
- An **unscripted** interrupted goal session (not planted, not known to the operator) was auto-resum

ed and its goal re-armed at boot; the round driver then continued the session.
- A session holding a

n active goal continued on an automatic continuation round with **no human message**.
- Round budget
s advanced correctly; a live session was correctly skipped; 489 subagent-owned sessions were correct
ly excluded in one pass.
`verify-d1.mjs` (included) turns any future closure into a one-command verdict: `PASS` (exit 0) / `F
AIL` (exit 1, names the broken check + evidence tail) / `VOID` (exit 2, no closure recorded after th
e plugin armed). Its own fixture selftest (`verify-d1.test.mjs`) exercises every verdict path agains
t synthetic evidence trees.
## Design notes
- **Policy is explicit and minimal**: only durable goal phase `active` auto-resumes; paused/blocked
goals are deliberate human states and are never re-armed; non-goal sessions are surfaced only. The p

lugin's installation *is* the one-time authorization.
- **Resume mirrors the harness's own resume fl
ow** (`agents.resume({resumeSessionId, agentOptions, setup})` + `goals.resume(agent, {id, revision})
`), including binding the default model — a resume without a model binding produces turns failing wi
th `prompt variable "{{model}}" has no value` (the agent loop binds that variable from `agent.option

s`). This plugin binds it and logs a loud `resume-no-model` line if it cannot.
- **It never hand-app
ends to session logs.** Session-log append contracts (`headerSeq` must reference an earlier request/

header) make cold-log markers unsafe; detection is recorded in the plugin's own log instead.
- **Fai
l-closed everywhere**: goal resume throws on exhausted budgets or invalid phase transitions (caught,
logged, never retried); the boot pass, classification, logging, and resume are each guarded so a pl
ugin failure cannot block host boot.
## Install (as a local profile plugin)

1. Copy this package to `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-auto-resume`.
2. Link it into your profile's dep
endencies and add it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
3. The package's own `cordis.patch.yml` carries the required insert row (a bundles-list entry alone
is silently skipped). It ships with `dryRun: true` — the first boot logs `would-resume` decisions wi

thout acting; verify them against your live sessions, then set `dryRun: false`.
4. Restart the app.
Evidence lands in `~/.dsh/logs/session-auto-resume.log` (`ARMED` on every activation, one `pass-done
ds in `~/.dsh/logs/session-auto-resume.log` (`ARMED` on every activation, one `pass-done` per boot).

## Status

- Selftest: all legs green under the app runtime (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`).
- Live fire: one real clo

sure-recovery verified end to end; one defect found and fixed during it (the model binding above).
-
Known limitation: sessions are matched against the most recent 30 persisted sessions by creation ti
me (config `scanLimit`), and the mechanism mounts at boot only (no hot reload of plugin-file changes
(config `scanLimit`), and the mechanism mounts at boot only (no hot reload of plugin-file changes).
